prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production painted 2D fantasy chess game sprite sheet
Input images: Image 1 is the original King Down Bishop identity reference; Image 2 is an accepted painted 2D Knight pair for brushwork, registration, transparency and army-colour treatment; Image 3 is the Knight's original reference; Image 4 is an accepted painted wrist-bow Archer pair for the same visual language. Use Image 1 for identity and equipment, the accepted painted sheets only for style/layout.

Create a 1536x1024 landscape sprite sheet on GENUINE transparent alpha with EXACTLY TWO complete full-body Bishop characters side by side, one per equal 768x1024 cell. The two characters are matched in proportions, pose and scale, with clear empty alpha around every edge. No background, glow, haze, vignette, ground, checkerboard, text or labels.

Identity must follow the original Bishop: a tall split Bishop hat with two clear pointed lobes and central notch, masked scholarly face with visible eyes, long magenta-derived robe, one hand holding a closed black-and-gold book with a small glowing cross emblem, and a short dagger held in the other hand. Preserve the face mask, the book, the dagger, the long robe silhouette, shoulders and full hem. The Bishop is a calm full-body standing three-quarter figure, facing RIGHT, with natural hands and feet visible. Keep the book and dagger rigid and close to the torso so all equipment fits safely in the cell. Do not turn this into a generic wizard, a staff-bearing priest, an armour knight, a horse, or a floating bust.

Style/medium: confident hand-painted 2D fantasy character illustration with faceted soft brush shading and readable edges, matching the accepted Knight and Archer sheets. Avoid photorealism, 3D render, plastic, toy, or vector-flat treatment. Use a narrow coherent pose suitable for board-scale sprites.

Left cell: dominant warm ivory/cream robe, hat, shoulders, sleeves and boots, with charcoal ink accents. Right cell: dominant dark charcoal/slate robe, hat, shoulders, sleeves and boots, with readable cool-grey edge highlights. Original magenta/pink becomes ONLY a small recognition accent under 8 percent of visible surface: narrow hat lining, tiny book/dagger accent or sash edge. Preserve the book as mostly black with restrained muted gold page edge and small cross motif; no large magenta cloth. The army colours must dominate the entire figure.

Composition and registration: same standing stance in both halves; complete split hat tips around local y90-120, boot soles around local y920-955, full figure within local x120..640, with at least 70px transparent margin. Keep the pointed hat tall but not clipped. Both feet fully visible and planted with a little separation. No cutoffs, no detached parts, no extra poses, no duplicated equipment. Make the two cells equal in scale and aligned by foot baseline.
